deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

display_name.description: The editable display name of the inventory report configuration. Has a limit of 256 characters. Can be empty.
display_name.rationale: The display name is used for identification and readability purposes and does not directly affect security controls or access management.

force_destroy.description: If set, all the inventory report details associated with this report configuration are deleted.

location.description:
The location of the ReportConfig. The source and destination buckets specified in the ReportConfig
must be in the same location.
location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: This argument specifies the project context only and does not directly introduce security risks or enforce security controls.

csv_options.description: Options for configuring the format of the inventory report CSV file.

csv_options.delimiter.description: The delimiter used to separate the fields in the inventory report CSV file.
csv_options.delimiter.rationale: Delimiter configuration is related to CSV formatting and does not directly impact security enforcement or permissions.

csv_options.header_required.description: The boolean that indicates whether or not headers are included in the inventory report CSV file.
csv_options.header_required.rationale: Boolean controlling whether the inventory report CSV includes a header row. This is a cosmetic file-formatting choice with no bearing on access, encryption, or exposure; readability is not a security control.

csv_options.record_separator.description: The character used to separate the records in the inventory report CSV file.
csv_options.record_separator.rationale: Record separator settings only affect file formatting and do not directly influence security controls.

frequency_options.description: Options for configuring how inventory reports are generated.

frequency_options.frequency.description: The frequency in which inventory reports are generated. Values are DAILY or WEEKLY. Possible values: ["DAILY", "WEEKLY"]
frequency_options.frequency.rationale: Selects how often inventory reports are generated (DAILY or WEEKLY). This is an operational/data-management cadence choice for the team; report frequency does not enable, encrypt, or expose anything, and pinning a specific value like 'weekly' is not a structural security control.

frequency_options.end_date.description: The date to stop generating inventory reports. For example, {"day": 15, "month": 9, "year": 2022}.

frequency_options.end_date.day.description: The day of the month to stop generating inventory reports.

frequency_options.end_date.month.description: The month to stop generating inventory reports.

frequency_options.end_date.year.description: The year to stop generating inventory reports

frequency_options.start_date.description: The date to start generating inventory reports. For example, {"day": 15, "month": 8, "year": 2022}.

frequency_options.start_date.day.description: The day of the month to start generating inventory reports.

frequency_options.start_date.month.description: The month to start generating inventory reports.

frequency_options.start_date.year.description: The year to start generating inventory reports

object_metadata_report_options.description: Options for including metadata in an inventory report.

object_metadata_report_options.metadata_.description: The metadata fields included in an inventory report.
object_metadata_report_options.metadata_.rationale: Selects which object metadata fields are emitted into the inventory report. This shapes report content for the team's own monitoring needs and does not grant access, encrypt, or expose the underlying data; restricting which fields appear is a data-management choice, not a structural security control.

object_metadata_report_options.storage_d.description: Options for where the inventory reports are stored.
The destination bucket that stores the generated inventory reports.
The path within the destination bucket to store generated inventory reports.
object_metadata_report_options.storage_d.rationale: Specifies the path within the destination bucket where generated inventory reports are written. This is a reference to a location in another resource; platform policy does not constrain where teams choose to store outputs, and 'access control' is governed by the bucket's own IAM/exposure settings, not this path string.

object_metadata_report_options.storage_f.description: The filter to use when specifying which bucket to generate inventory reports for.

parquet_options.description: An option for outputting inventory reports as parquet files.
